name: Meadow Spine
design_intent:
MEADOW MILE #14 — a calm spine-lite: one thin trampoline ridge with a spring perch 600px out at each end and a central spring throne above, over a SHALLOW void (the meadow's forgiving take on the High Wire ridge). Exposure without a bottomless drop — the recovery gamble is real but the void is shallow, so it teaches edge play gently.

GEOMETRY (centred x=0): central RIDGE (trampoline x0..1200 top880 h72). Two spring PERCHES flank it at ridge height 600px out — LEFT (x-880..-600) 600px from the ridge's left end (x0), RIGHT (x1800..2080) 600px from the ridge's right end (x1200). One central spring THRONE (x430..770 top360 h48) hangs 520px above the ridge. Full-width SHALLOW lethal void (rim y960); bounds -1300..2380 keep the perch outer edges ~300-420px inside the side blast (spine-lite exposure); bottom y1620 leaves 668px recovery sky under the ridge.

MOVEMENT (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270 / bubblegum 180 / spring 480; zero-boost drift ~395 tramp / ~527 spring max; normal_boost_max 760 crosses a 620px gap in <0.9s @ ~24 fuel; super 2800 clears all):
- REACH a PERCH: ridge end to perch = 600px of open void. > 527 max spring drift and >> 395 trampoline ridge drift. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY.
- RETURN from a perch: the perch spring launches 480px up but the 600px gap back still exceeds the 527 spring drift, so leaving a perch also needs a boost — flight both directions. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB to the THRONE (top360): 520px above the ridge (880). Trampoline apex 270 reaches y610 -> 250px short. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- RECOVER: ridge bottom (952) to bottom blast (1620) = 668px recovery sky (>= 650, shallow but still a gamble); the thin ridge gives little runway so a launched player rarely re-lands (high kill-per-exchange). Verb: FLY.
- Both perch gaps exceed a spring bounce's reach and the throne sits above spring apex, so flight is required. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing.
